ns2:section.sectionText: What is fascism? Can the study of religion help us understand fascism? How do fascism and religion bear on America? Addressing these and other important questions, this interdisciplinary seminar moves through relevant readings in political theory, investigative journalism, American history, cultural criticism, and social fiction. Research projects allow each participant to supplement our collective effort by exploring an individual interest in greater detail.
